account: The International Telecommunication Union entry names the Vellore Institute of Technology, Chennai campus, as the developer. The prototype combines environmental data with neural models to predict low-oxygen conditions. The makers report no forecast accuracy for the prototype. The entry lists the National Institute of Oceanography and the Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services under testbeds. Proposed pilots cover hypoxia-prone seas, and intended responses include nutrient management and fishing restrictions. No source documents alert-driven interventions, avoided fish mortality or preserved fishing income.
